name: dokan-zaman-landing-page-v4
description: Dokan Zaman General Supplies — V4 Arabic RTL landing page built around a scroll-driven supply box. Tailwind is compiled ahead of time; the published page is plain HTML/CSS/JS with no runtime dependencies.

scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/main.js assets/js/story.js assets/js/quote-form.js -c -m --comments false -o assets/js/main.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
